mcp_tools.name: link_rot_scan_and_notarized_archive
mcp_tools.title: Link rot scan and notarized archive
mcp_tools.description: Submit a link-integrity evidence manifest (scan posture, declared link rows with observed statuses, archive captures, canonicalization, notarization records, serving and repair records); get a deterministic LINK_INTEGRITY_SOUND / LINK_INTEGRITY_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed archived/notarized-citation and rotted-citation-repaired checks, with per-check evidence. Audits declared scan evidence; it does not fetch URLs.

inputSchema.description: The link-integrity evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and links[] schema).

scan.description: Scan-coverage evidence (scheduled, statuses and content hashes recorded, cadence current).

links.description: Declared link rows with observed statuses, capture and notarization fields.

archive.description: Archive-capture evidence (format, fallback chain, cite-time capture).

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization evidence (trackers stripped, redirects resolved, dedupe by hash).

notarization.description: Notarization evidence (SHA-256, RFC 3161 / transparency-log timestamps, verification recipe).

serving.description: Honest-serving evidence (as-seen views, provenance badge, never presented as current).

repair.description: Repair evidence (repairs logged, no silent drops).

compliance.description: Compliance evidence (robots/ToS, rate limits, no access-control bypass).
